name: Wellness and Oversight for Psychological Resources Act
description: Illinois statute prohibiting any person, corporation, or entity from offering or providing therapy or psychotherapy services through artificial intelligence unless conducted by a licensed behavioural health professional, and barring AI chatbots from making independent therapeutic decisions, generating treatment plans without licensed review, or directly conducting therapeutic communication with clients.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Illinois State (illinois.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Illinois State (illinois.gov).
